t: Heavy duty backpack with dual zipped opening and various sized loops in each compartment to allow for secure positioning and organization of tools. Features external, internal and tool pockets alongside water-resistant plastic base, adjustable shoulder straps and handle. Also includes a large compartment which can be used for either a power tool or a laptop. The provision of additional back padding delivers comfort and support. Extendable straps enable easy access to tools stored in front compartment.
